asr.full_text: My advice for women entering the technology field would be to be proactive when trying to grow your career and your skills. Don't wait for opportunities to come to you but go out there and create those opportunities. Don't worry about knowing everything, even experts are not experts in everything. Be passionate about learning and enjoy the ride. Enjoy what you do, keep on learning and don't give up easily. Keep yourself up to date and it is good to take risks and challenges. Never allow yourself or others to place limits on your abilities and to always look for opportunities to learn. It's high time that women should stop doubting their own capabilities and start believing that we are best at what they do. If you won't believe in yourself then no one else will. So never be afraid to show the best version of yourself. The woman in tech that inspires me the most is Cheryl Sandburg. In addition to being the COO of Facebook at a young age, she also co-founded initiatives like LeanIn, which is highly commendable and inspirational Colleen Waymel. She is the CEO of an HR technology and services company where I first got my career started and introduced to the world of tech. Michelle San, she is the co founder of the company in Hong Kong called first coat Academy Academy and she was a software Engineer in our siliconed Valley. I think she's brilliant. She's charm So I just followed her path. Apart from being a chairperson at Infosys foundation. She's a brilliant engineer She's an amazing author. She is a determined doer She is a resilient social worker the way she stood up against all the odds of the society to provide equal opportunities for women at work, is an inspiration to all of us. Every woman around me, who thinks diversely and brings up broader approach for better solutions. Women in technology, who have not only broken though the glass ceiling, but who are giving back, who are getting the message across, who are helping other women pursue their goals by sponsoring programs such as TIF and Women on the Move such as Loribier.
